otterMail.name: Otter Drive
otterMail.description: Your drives' documents in a Drive workspace, and attachments saved from mail.
otterMail.dataUse: Sends Otter Drive only what you upload or choose to save: the attachment or the email, with the title you give it, into the drive you pick. Everyone with access to that drive can see it. Your Otter Drive sign-in, and which drives are on, stay on this device.
